name: Community — Qwen Image 2.1
author: michaeldune
description: Qwen-Image 2.1, the 7B model that writes, edits and cuts out in one: text-to-image with accurate lettering, editing from up to four reference pictures, and background removal to a real transparent PNG. A fourth card turns one picture of a person into a front / back / head-angles character sheet (adds a 328 MB LoRA). Two 4MP cards: text to image at the model's full 4-megapixel size, and Enhance to 4MP, which adds real detail to any picture you give it (adds a 76 MB LoRA). About 16 seconds for a 1024 px picture on a 12 GB card; the Fast Drafts card (since 1.5.0) makes one in about 11 seconds with Viggle's 5-step turbo LoRA (adds 1.36 GB). The Fast Edit card (since 1.6.0) edits with PrunaAI's 8-step LoRA (adds 336 MB): about 20 seconds for a one-picture edit instead of about 80, best with one picture. One 17 GB download covers every other card. LICENCE: the weights are under the Qwen Research License, which allows NON-COMMERCIAL use only; do not use these cards for paid or commercial work.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1
presets.tagline: Fast text-to-image with lettering that spells
presets.description: Text-to-image with Qwen-Image 2.1. Follows long natural-language prompts and renders quoted text on signs, labels and posters correctly. For a transparent result, start the prompt with: This is an RGBA image with transparency. and end it with: The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent. Since 1.4.0 it uses guided sampling for much cleaner lettering and detail: about 35 seconds per picture on a 12 GB card. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE). All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). Tested 2026-09-20 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (stock ComfyUI master): 16 s per 1024x1024 or 1344x768 picture at 25 steps, about 9.4 GB VRAM in use; a five-word shop sign came out letter-perfect; the RGBA prompt produced real alpha. SINCE 1.4.0 (2026-09-22): guided sampling - CFG 3, 20 steps, seeds_2/sgm_uniform, Adaptive Projected Guidance (1/10/0.3) and FreSca (1/2/8), with a negative prompt - replacing the Comfy template's CFG 1. Tested on 2 prompts x 3 seeds (text to image) and 2 seeds (edit, 1 and 4 references): lettering on signs and menus went from mostly garbled to readable, colour stayed natural, identities held; about 2.4x the time (1 MP text to image ~34 s, one-reference edit ~88 s, four references ~6 min on a 4070 Ti). IN THE APP (2026-09-22): text to image 44 s with a letter-perfect sign and menu; one-reference edit 95 s, identity and clothes kept. The negative prompt is built into the workflow (StringConcatenate) because the app sends an empty negative_prompt; anything the user types is appended.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Fast Drafts
presets.tagline: Five-step drafts in a few seconds
presets.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 text-to-image in 5 steps instead of 20-25, using Viggle's turbo LoRA (v0.2 preview, built in). About 11 seconds per picture on a 12 GB card, against about 40 for the main card, so it is the card for trying ideas and seeds quickly; move a keeper to the main Qwen Image 2.1 card for the final picture. Photos, portraits and poster headlines hold up well; small or long lettering garbles more often than on the main card, and now and then an object comes out doubled, so re-roll the seed. Steps and CFG are fixed by the distillation, so there are no sliders. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE); the Viggle LoRA is a derivative under the same licence. Shares the pack's Qwen-Image 2.1 weights (int8 ConvRot model 7.3 GB, int8 Qwen3-VL 8B encoder 9.4 GB, VAE 0.7 GB) and adds Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo v0.2 (Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo-v0.2-5step-lora-r256.safetensors, rank 256, 1.36 GB, DMD-distilled; repo commit e57a0bb, sha256 pinned in the pack checksums) through LoraLoaderModelOnly at strength 1 after SimpliGen's LoRA slot. Sampling per the model card: 5 steps, euler, CFG 1, no negative, on the nodes [1, 0.875, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25]; those are RAW nodes that diffusers time-shifts, and ManualSigmas skips the model shift, so the workflow carries them pre-shifted for ~1 MP (mu 0.6935: 1, 0.93446, 0.85833, 0.66667, 0.4, 0); every aspect ratio in the table is within 0.4% of that mu. Tested 2026-09-23 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine, int8 base), 5 prompts x 3 seeds against the 25-step base: portrait, poster and a one-reference edit on par; a small shop sign garbled more (1 of 3 misspelled, 1 of 3 with a doubled accordion) and a product edit merged the shoe on 1 of 3 - this card is text-to-image only. Steady state ~3 s per new seed vs ~12 s for the old 25-step base (text encode ~4 s more on a new prompt, same for both); the first run after another Qwen card spends ~5 s patching the LoRA in. Peak VRAM ~11.5 GB. IN THE APP (2026-09-23): 4 pictures (3:4 poster, two 16:9 photo seeds, 9:16 interior) at 11.1 s each; the app re-encodes the prompt and re-applies the LoRA on every job, so the 3 s reseed seen on the bare engine does not happen in the app. Poster headline and tagline letter-perfect, a small chalkboard sign readable, nothing doubled.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Edit
presets.tagline: Edit or combine up to four pictures by describing the change
presets.description: Describe the edit in plain words and refer to the pictures by position: Keep the woman in <image1> unchanged, put the jacket from <image2> on her. One to four reference pictures; each extra one adds time (about 1 1/2 minutes for one and 6 minutes for four on a 12 GB card, since 1.4.0 switched to guided sampling for cleaner detail). The result uses the aspect ratio you pick, so choose the one that matches your first picture when the framing should stay the same. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Fast Edit
presets.description: Describe the edit and refer to the pictures by position, as on the main Edit card: Change the thread in <image1> to green. Eight steps with PrunaAI's few-step LoRA (v0.1, built in) instead of guided sampling, so a one-picture edit takes about 20 seconds on a 12 GB card instead of about 80. Best with ONE picture: colour and clothing changes, weather and time of day, swapping a word on a sign all held up in testing. With two or three pictures it is still much faster than the main Edit card but less reliable: small objects can deform and a picture can end up partly hidden, so re-roll the seed or use the main Edit card for a final multi-picture composite. Up to three pictures. Steps and CFG are fixed by the distillation, so there are no sliders. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE); the Pruna LoRA is a derivative under the same licence. Same int8 base, encoder and VAE as the other cards plus PrunaAI/Pruna-Qwen-Image-2.1 p_qwen_image_2.1_8step_v0.1 (336 MB, rank-64 DMD distillation, trained at 1K with up to 3 references; pinned to revision 113e63b, sha256 f0865d68...bb15). Recipe per the model card: LoRA strength 1.0, euler, CFG 1, empty negative, sigmas 1, 14/15, 6/7, 10/13, 2/3, 6/11, 0.4, 2/9, 0 used UNSHIFTED (ManualSigmas). Graph = the Edit card minus APG/FreSca/negative prompt, LoRA before the reference prefix cache; the fourth reference slot is removed because the distillation covers three. Tested 2026-09-25 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine), same seeds against the main Edit card. One reference, 3 sources: 3/3 correct (dress colour + lanterns with the face kept, snow + a changed chalkboard word with the shop sign intact, thread colour + an added magnifier), sampler 5 s vs 54 s. Two or three references, 3 cases: 2/3 usable (a woman placed at a shop door; woman + shop + cat on her lap) and 1/3 failed (tweezers stretched into a blade, part of a menu hidden), sampler 11-19 s vs 138-216 s. PrunaAI call v0.1 work in progress; re-pin when they publish a new version. IN THE APP (2026-09-25, test pack): one-reference menu edit (a price changed from 5 to 7, a coffee cup drawn in) 20.7 s including the cold model load, every other menu line untouched; two-reference edit (woman from one picture at the door of the bakery in the other, holding a bread bag) 28.4 s, shop sign and chalkboard unchanged.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Cutout
presets.tagline: Remove the background, get a transparent PNG

The instruction is built in; use the prompt box only to say what to keep (for example: keep the microphone and the cable). The result always has the size and shape of your picture; the aspect ratio setting is ignored. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

Samples on the latent the encoder returns for the reference, so the cut-out lines up with the source pixel for pixel (rounded to a multiple of 32, about 1 MP). The brief is the model card's own (Remove the background, and output a PNG image) plus a keep-the-whole-subject sentence, with {{prompt}} appended as extra notes. The bare model-card line followed by an empty prompt deleted the subject's jacket and hair on 1 of 3 seeds; with the keep sentence 18 of 18 portrait renders were identical in coverage. Card template tested on a portrait, a B&W profile, a sneaker on a cluttered bench and a long-haired dog, two seeds each: 8 of 8 clean, 16-22 s. A picture with no clear subject (a street scene) comes back mostly or fully transparent.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Character Sheet
presets.tagline: One picture of a person in, a front / back / head-angles sheet out
presets.description:
Turns one picture of a person into a character reference sheet on a white background: a large head in the middle, a headless full-body front view on the left, a full-body back view on the right, and two small side profiles facing each other underneath. The layout comes from the Portrait2CharRef LoRA by b675051045971, which is built in, and so is the brief; the prompt box is only for extra notes.

PICTURE 1 (required) = the person. A full-body picture keeps the whole outfit, bag and shoes included. A head-and-shoulders portrait works too, but the clothes below the shoulders are then invented and change with the seed.
PICTURE 2 (optional) = an outfit. Add a picture of clothes and the sheet dresses the person in them.

SET THE ASPECT RATIO TO 3:2. The LoRA was trained for that shape and other shapes break the layout. About 30 s on a 12 GB card, about 50 s with an outfit picture. The large head keeps the angle of your picture, so use a front-facing one for a front-facing head. The back view sometimes keeps its head; only the front view is meant to be headless.

Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License). The LoRA itself is free to use (Civitai, all permissions open).

Tested 2026-09-21 in the app through the Edit card with the same LoRA and brief, 3:2 (1216x832), seeds 4242/4243, 9 runs: layout correct 9 of 9 (headless front, mirrored profiles), identity held 9 of 9; sources were two studio portraits, a head crop of the author's own example, a full-body street photo (coat, scarf, sweater, bag, trousers and boots all kept on both seeds) and a portrait plus an outfit-only picture (suit applied, face kept). Without the LoRA the base model keeps the front figure's head and draws both profiles facing the same way. 2 of 9 back views kept the head.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 4MP
presets.tagline: Text to image at the model's full 4-megapixel size
presets.description: The same model as the Qwen Image 2.1 card, run at the size Qwen publishes for it: about 4 megapixels (2048 x 2048 square, 2752 x 1536 wide). Much finer skin, hair and fabric than the 1 MP card, and small lettering comes out cleaner. About 1.5 minutes per picture on a 12 GB card at 25 steps; for signs and small lettering, raise the steps to 40 (about 2.5 minutes). Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Enhance to 4MP
presets.tagline: Any picture in, the same picture at 4 megapixels with real detail
presets.description: Drop in a picture (one you made or any photo) and get it back at about 4 megapixels with fine detail added: skin, hair, fabric and surfaces. The composition, faces, lettering, colours and lighting stay; the aspect ratio of your picture is kept, so the aspect ratio setting is ignored. Uses the Detail Enhancer LoRA by Elusarca (76 MB, built in). The prompt box is optional: add what should look sharper or what to keep. It does not repair things that are wrong in the picture, such as misspelled text. About 2 minutes on a 12 GB card. Non-commercial use only (Qwen Research License).

extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: LICENCE: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE). All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or newer (the first release with Qwen-Image 2.1 support, core commit 6bfaacc67). This card adds Elusarca's Qwen 2.1 Detail Enhancer LoRA (Civitai model 2956730 v1.0, 76 MB; licence: image use including commercial, credit required, no derivatives; sha256 pinned in the pack checksums) through LoraLoaderModelOnly at strength 1, ahead of SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. The picture is Lanczos-scaled to about 4 MP at its own shape (ImageScaleToTotalPixels, multiple of 32), VAE-encoded as the starting latent and re-noised to 0.8, so layout, faces and lettering carry over; the encoder also sees the picture at 1 MP with the author's recommended brief plus {{prompt}}. Tested 2026-09-22 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB, one seed per setting: from an empty latent (full redraw) the detail was strongest but small faces in a group shot changed and a correct menu word was misspelled (TONKOTSU -> TOMIOTSU); denoise 0.5-0.7 kept everything but added little and slipped one letter; 0.8 kept the face, layout and every letter with added fine detail, about 2 minutes, peak 11.2 GB. Encoding the picture at 2048 instead of 1024 doubled the time with no visible gain. IN THE APP (2026-09-22, engine 0.37.0, NVIDIA driver 617.14): a menu board (every letter kept), a six-person group shot (faces kept) and a close-up portrait (face and eyes kept, finer skin and hair), 110-115 s each.
